preconditions.description: The number of stewards n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each steward's strength must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(1 for a_i in a if any(a_j < a_i for a_j in a) and any(a_j > a_i for a_j in a)))
postconditions.description: The output must be the count of stewards Jon will support, where each supported steward has at least one weaker and one stronger steward.
